column8: [087](reports/087-anthropic-fellows-program-2026-05-18.md) | OVERRIDE-APPLY per user request despite NO SPONSOR + archetype-stretch. H-1B EXPLICIT NO SPONSOR ("We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows" - JD verbatim); user STEM OPT covers 4-mo duration but NO full-time sponsorship pathway downstream (dead-end for H-1B track). Remote-US/UK/Canada or Berkeley/London; $3,850/wk stipend = ~$66.5K total over 4 mo + ~$15K/mo compute funding (research budget not personal comp); 4-mo fellowship, no full-time guarantee. ARCHETYPE 2-LEVEL STRETCH: ML research fellowship vs user's marketing-analyst primary archetypes. Only Economics & Policy of the 5 workstreams matches (AI Safety, AI Security, ML Systems & Performance, RL are CS/ML research seats out of fit). PYTHON FLUENCY direct: SwipeHire (Python+OpenAI API+React) + NSE Bot (Python+Claude API agentic reasoning over news/catalysts) + Cost of Living Analysis (pandas/Matplotlib) + Simon Data Management coursework. LLM EXPERIENCE strong: 4 Anthropic Claude certifications (Claude 101, Claude Code 101, Claude Cowork, Building with Claude API) + 2 production LLM products solo + Cursor/Claude daily workflow + Pixis AI adtech platform trainer for 8 enterprise marketers. EMPIRICAL/STATS adjacent: Credit Card Prediction Models (R 10-fold CV + exhaustive feature selection + interaction vs baseline regression) + Optimal Pricing Prediction (R linear regression demand elasticity) + R Analysis & Chatbot for Learning Center + Sensata holdout-incrementality experiment muscle via Pixis (matched holdout vs exposed 3 wk, 3x ROAS). ECONOMICS & POLICY anchor: Sensata global pricing strategy Industrial BU + AP26 revenue model influence + $627M Power BI executive dashboard 1,200 opportunities (+12% YoY revenue, 8% market share) + Simon Pricing Analytics + Advanced Pricing + Pricing Policies coursework + Econ & Marketing Strategy TA = closest "pricing economics under AI deployment" practitioner-research surface. GAPS: no published ML research, no academic ML lab affiliation, no LLM/RL/safety research portfolio, no formal OSS catalogued. STRATEGY: research-proposal-driven application around "how LLM-enabled price-discovery shifts pricing dynamics in low-liquidity industrial markets" (defensible Economics & Policy question from Sensata practitioner + LLM-builder credibility); resume + proposal in open-field. SUB-5% realistic acceptance odds per external observer estimates. ALSO PIVOT TO OTHER ANTHROPIC ROLES IN PARALLEL: Anthropic hires for Growth/PMM/Marketing Analyst/Pricing Strategy seats that may sponsor H-1B separately from Fellows (higher base-rate fit). Growth+AI portfolio (adhithyabhaskar.vercel.app/ref/anthropic-fellows); CV ✅; CL N/A (Fellows applications typically have open research-proposal field instead of CL); outreach minimal (no named hiring manager per workstream).
